title: How to be beautiful forever - a note from living gently in the forest
en: whenever i meet a person i often notice their eyes i particularly love those little wrinkles that form around them when they smile i enjoy when someone shares a topic they're passionate about their face has a way of lighting up and the vibrancy is in their voice when someone is kind they shine a light that makes others feel as if the world is a little better than a minute before so i know what it is to have no self-esteem and when i was able to finally crawl out of that hole and find that stability in regards to how i see myself i was surprised that being comfortable wasn't necessarily being confident in how i looked it was simply being at peace with who i was to give a very silly example i'm told quite often online that i have an unfortunately large nose it comes with the territory of being someone on the internet these comments are often attempting to make me feel self-conscious but i'm happy to say it doesn't because it relies on me agreeing with their

perception and internalizing it and that is where my power lies and yours does too indeed words become real only if you believe they are when you get to that place it's incredible to feel that freedom and all time spent critiquing my own or others external selves seems like a waste of potential my life minutes could be used in so many other wondrous ways i asked all of you what made a person beautiful and without fail i got the words of compassion and honesty and that's interesting because in a way those are some of the easiest things to be it may be hard at the very start when we have layers of fear and hurt in our way but once those walls come down we're

free and just like that we become something so beautiful it cannot be described through a physical representation we can spend the rest of time debating physical beauty but i would really like to spend that time wondering how i can cultivate a beauty that lasts forever i think that's a far more interesting question i have been working on this little bunny

rabbit all morning and i have to say it has filled me with so much joy i am always surprised by the little things that bring me little moments of just happiness throughout the day and this is one of them i think getting creative and making something um you know that isn't necessarily very complicated or anything but just something that brings you joy it's so beautiful and i think so important on a daily basis you know if it's possible depending on the person you know there are different things that may bring you joy i know for a lot of people it's coffee for some people it may be their pets you know laying in bed after a long day of work cupcakes and cookies for me today what brings me joy is painting a little bunny with a mushroom cap because it's so simple but something about it just making my day so metimes it's just simplest most sometimes it's just simplest most darling little things that make all the difference
zh: 每当我遇到一个人时，我经常注意到他们的眼睛，我特别喜欢他们微笑时在他们周围形成的那些小皱纹，我喜欢有人分享一个他们热衷的话题，他们的脸有一种发光的方式，他们的声音充满活力，当有人友善时，他们发出光芒，让别人感觉世界比一分钟前好一点，所以我知道没有自尊是什么感觉，当我终于能够从那个洞里爬出来，找到我如何看待自己的稳定性时，我很惊讶舒适并不一定是对自己的外表充满信心，只是与自己的形象保持和平。举一个非常愚蠢的例子，我经常在网上被告知，不幸的是，我有一个大鼻子，这是互联网上某个人的领土，这些评论经常试图让我感到不自在，但我很高兴地说，事实并非如此，因为这取决于我是否同意他们的观点。

感知和内化它，这就是我的力量所在，你的也确实如此，只有当你相信它们是当你到达那个地方时，言语才变得真实，感觉自由和所有时间花在批评自己或其他外在自我上是令人难以置信的，这似乎是浪费潜力我的生命时间可以用在许多其他奇妙的方式上我问你们所有人是什么使一个人美丽，毫无疑问我得到了同情和诚实的话语，这很有趣，因为在某种程度上，这些是一些最容易成为的事情一开始可能会很困难，因为我们有层层恐惧和伤害，但一旦这些墙倒塌，我们就会
自由，就像这样，我们变得如此美丽，无法通过物理表征来描述，我们可以花剩下的时间讨论物理美，但我真的很想花时间思考如何培养一种永恒的美丽，我认为这是一个更有趣的问题，我一直在研究这只小兔子

整个早上我不得不说它让我充满了快乐，我总是对那些给我带来快乐的小事情感到惊讶，这就是其中之一，我认为发挥创意并制作一些东西，嗯，你知道，这不一定很复杂，或者什么，但只是给你带来快乐的东西，它是如此美丽，我认为每天都很重要，你知道是否有可能，取决于你认识的人，有不同的东西可以给你带来快乐，我知道对很多人来说，这就是咖啡人们，可能是他们的宠物，你认识的，在结束一整天的工作后，躺在床上给我做纸杯蛋糕和饼干，今天给我带来快乐的是画一只戴着蘑菇帽的小兔子，因为它很简单，但它的某些东西让我的一天变得很美好，所以有时它只是最简单的，有时它只是最简单的，最可爱的小事情，让一切变得不同
